fact: The Government of Niger reports that on 4 March 2026 the Interior Minister opened, with UNICEF support, a national workshop to build a national strategy for local fiscal resource mobilisation, and that UNICEF has supported local tax optimisation in 44 communes (17 percent) of Diffa, Agadez and Tahoua since 2023.
title: Ouverture à Niamey de l'atelier national sur la mobilisation des ressources fiscales des collectivités territoriales
